QuestInfo.name: Victoria or Bust
QuestInfo.0: Your training continues. You must keep progressing until the Black Mage is defeated once and for all. You should ask #b#p1201000##k what to do next.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1201000# says you can only train so much in #m140000000# and suggests you venture to #bVictoria Island#k. She directs you to an ally of hers, #b#p1002104# the Information Dealer#k, in #b#m104000004##k.

In order to reach #m104000000#, you must leave #m140000000# by boarding a ship. From town, head to your right and continue past the snow-covered field to arrive at a small port operated by penguins. \nOnce there, talk to #b#p1200003##k to board the ship. \n
QuestInfo.2: #p1002104# the Information Dealer was once a resident of #m140000000# eagerly awaiting the hero's revival, but he eventually lost hope and left town. He's a distant cousin of #p1201000#. He must have felt bad about leaving #p1201000# all by herself, because he promised to help her anytime she needed it.

default.0: You still haven't gone to #m104000000##k in #bVictoria Island? Just head east past town until you reach the #bharbor#k, then get on board the ship. The first ride will be free, so no worries there.

item.0: Hm? Are you here to purchase some valuable information? But I do have a rule here with the sales of information. I do not sell information to anyone that does not have a letter of introduction with them. Sorry, but I need you to #bget a letter of introduction from someone you know#k.

lost.0: Oh no, did you lose the letter? Without it, no one will believe that you're a hero... I'll write you another one, and please don't lose it this time.
